name: deepx_auto_character_pipeline
description: Automated Master Character & Universal Entity Pipeline (from AnyAI): Generates character, vehicle, animal, or product reference images in bulk, assigns orderly names (#001_character, #002_character), uploads them to Google Flow's asset library, and optionally generates detailed video prompts referencing those characters back-to-back using continuous scene concatenation (is_concat=true). If script_text or raw_input is provided without characters array, automatically extracts and registers all entities.

characters.description: List of characters or entities to generate and register. If omitted, extracted from script_text.

prompt.description: Portrait generation prompt describing character appearance, clothes, and style.

raw_input.description: Alias for script_text: raw story, prompt, or script to auto-extract characters and universal entities from.

script_text.description: Optional raw script or story. If characters array is omitted, entities will be auto-detected from this script.

video_scenes.description: Optional list of sequential video scenes to generate back-to-back.

action_prompt.description: What happens in this video scene.
